Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 6 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Shear Line
Issued at: 8:00 AM, 04 November 2025(Tuesday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Quezon, Laguna and Batangas.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Nueva Ecija, Tarlac, Zambales, Pampanga, Bulacan and Metro Manila within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Rizal, Cavite and Bataan which may persist within 3 hours.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 11:00 AM today.
For more information and queries, please call telephone numbers 8927-1335 and 8927-2877 or log on to https://t.co/59mTpZJq1n.
